_meta.what: Mean V2Tone of each channel's MATCHED articles -- the same articles the registered dictionaries selected and the receipts pages enumerate; tone is an annotation joined by URL in GDELT's GKG, never a filter. Context axis only: tone enters no score, no percentile, and no composite. n_tone_found vs n_matched discloses the join rate; GKG does not carry every URL. Negative tone is conventional GDELT scaling (roughly -10 very negative to +10 very positive).
